confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on crowdsourced aggregates (Numbeo and Expatistan) that mostly fall between 2025 and early 2026, converted at roughly 26,000 VND per USD, a conversion assumption not from the searches. Beer is a blend of an Expatistan neighbourhood-pub figure last updated March 2024 and Numbeo's draft-beer average. Cocktail is a bar-level estimate drawn partly from rooftop-venue listings (about 90,000 to 200,000 VND). Wine by the glass has no direct Nha Trang price found; it is set from a from-90,000-VND glass listing and the local beer relationship. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Nha Trang's July beach-season pricing and were not checked against live listings or booking pages. The fx observation is the most recent RBA figure I could verify (20 March 2026), not an October 2026 rate, so it may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian coastal resort-city basis, anchored on Nha Trang-specific crowdsourced food and drink data. Accommodation is set from general knowledge of Vietnamese beach-resort tiers rather than any comparable-city dataset.
